items.title: Portable receipt-bundle exporter + offline verifier (no server)
items.context: Export a DONE story's gate evidence into one self-contained bundle, and add an offline verify that recomputes materialHash/headHash/storyFilesHash from the referenced git tree, re-checks the receipt-identity digests + local-key signatures + the binding chain, with NO Authority-server dependency. Build on core/authority-gate-receipt-verifier.ts + verifyAuthorityReceipt.
items.userSees: ✓ buildReceiptBundle exports a self-contained bundle (binding hashes + receipt identities + local-key signature); verifyReceiptBundleOffline returns {accepted:true} for an authentic bundle with the matching current materialHash — no Authority server contacted.

happy.desc: buildReceiptBundle() over a fixture DONE story's local evidence → a self-contained bundle; sign with a local ed25519 key; verifyReceiptBundleOffline(bundle, currentMaterialHash=bundle.materialHash, pubKey) → ACCEPTED, no network/server; WHY: proves the offline accept path end-to-end.

edge.desc: verifyReceiptBundleOffline labels the result single-host/local-key (not Authority strong proof) and tolerates a bundle whose optional Authority fields are absent; WHY: honest scope + no crash on local-only bundles.

adversarial.desc: a bundle whose materialHash != the supplied currentMaterialHash → REJECTED with reason 'stale' (freshness conjunct), without the tree; WHY: the freshness binding is enforced offline.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke builds an authentic bundle + verifyReceiptBundleOffline returns accepted (no server).
Result labeled local-key-single-host; local-only bundle tolerated.
Mismatched currentMaterialHash → REJECT reason=stale (freshness enforced offline).

items.title: Adversarial tamper-class contract test + lying-agent negative case
items.context: A smoke enumerating every tamper class (code byte-flip, evidence JSON edit, host-verdict swap, commandSet change, stale materialHash, forged/missing signature, missing build proof): each MUST be REJECTED by the offline verifier; an authentic bundle MUST be ACCEPTED; assert 0 false-accept and 0 false-reject. Plus a lying-agent case: a done/pass claim whose evidence is stale or forged is rejected with the precise reason. This contract-test table is the paper's C2 data proof.
items.userSees: ✓ receipt-bundle contract smoke passed: authentic ACCEPTED; every tamper class REJECTED (code/evidence/host-verdict/commandSet/materialHash/forged-sig/missing-sig/missing-build-proof); lying-agent stale+forged claim REJECTED with reason; 0 false-accept, 0 false-reject (N/N).

happy.desc: the authentic bundle is ACCEPTED (control against a block-everything verifier); WHY: proves the test is not vacuous.

edge.desc: each tamper class (code byte-flip, evidence JSON edit, host-verdict swap, commandSet change, stale materialHash, forged signature, missing signature, missing build-proof) flips ACCEPT→REJECT with the correct reason code; assert 0 false-accept; WHY: enumerates the tamper surface = the paper C2 data proof.

adversarial.desc: lying-agent: a done/pass claim whose evidence is stale (old materialHash) OR forged (re-signed with a wrong key) is REJECTED naming the precise reason; assert 0 false-reject on authentic; WHY: 'agent says done but it lied' is mechanically caught.

verificationEvidence.note: Authentic bundle ACCEPTED — control against a block-everything verifier (non-vacuous).
8 tamper classes each flip ACCEPT→REJECT with the correct reason code; 0 false-accept.
Lying-agent stale+forged claim REJECTED with reason; 0 false-reject on authentic.
